target.statement: UniLSeg-20 achieves 0.954 Fmean on the ECSSD salient object detection benchmark.

compute.basis: The target requires training UniLSeg-20, which involves pre-training on 20% of SA-1B (about 2.2M images) and fine-tuning on multiple datasets; the paper used 192 V100 GPUs, so reproducing on a single laptop is infeasible.

blockers: requires training on 20% of SA-1B (2.2M images) and multiple supervised datasets
original training used 192 Tesla V100 GPUs
no pre-trained model weights or training code provided
title: Universal Segmentation at Arbitrary Granularity with Language Instruction
